assessments.reasoning: I checked the publisher's verified v3.13.0 tag against its exact commit, independently fetched the exact official file over HTTPS, and verified its byte digest. I read the frozen cited passage (The module cache and The meta path, lines 172–189 and 273–293). The citation supports ordered search for a module when that search is reached, and also describes exhaustion. Its immediately following lines 295–314 require a parent package path for submodules and distinguish the traversal for the parent from traversal for the named child. Ordered probing stopped at the first spec, but all-decline search raised ModuleNotFoundError with no spec. For a dotted missing name with an unavailable parent, only the parent was submitted to finders. The frozen conditions allow this case without reaching a search for the requested child.
